result:
The reading-page task's outcome didn't list the owner's asks, so I rewrote it. It now ticks each of the five asks with what was delivered.

The text check was clean. I didn't open the Figma screens, so none of the `[x]` ticks is checked against the design; I took them from the original landing line. I also didn't screenshot the site: the task changed no site pages, and `layout-check` skipped itself for that reason.

The five asks:
- **Narrower text:** the article now sits at a 720 measure.
- **Light page:** white page on a gray canvas.
- **No right-hand TOC:** the page-contents and related links moved into the inner left sidebar.
- **Attached inner sidebar:** it shares the page block's top edge and height.
- **Colour permutations:** options (a)–(d) at 3440, (e) at 1920 and 1000; the notes recommend (a).

Nobody owned the task any more, so I appended the new outcome to its `task.jsonl` and logged a "rewrote" line in `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`.
